title: phyllanthus calocarpus
intro: Phyllanthus calocarpus, commonly known as the Green Globe, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving liver function, thanks to its antioxidant and hepatoprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus calocarpus are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and modulate the immune system, providing relief from various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus calocarpus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
